parsed.explanation: The quote appears verbatim in Theorem C's proof. In context the text concedes its inductive attempt fails: applying the hypothesis to the remainder gives D(M) = μ − D(R) ≥ μ − 1, contradicting the target D ≤ 1, and it abandons the argument mid-stream (garbled fragments included). The replacement 'recursive dichotomy' merely asserts 'the residual number of cuts required is at most n' with no argument; worse, its target multiset {1,1,2,2,…,2^{n−1},2^{n−1},2^n} sums to 3·2^n − 2 ≠ S_n, so it is not even a refinement of the stick. Elsewhere the text offers only n ≤ 2/3 numerical checks and an unproved remark about the specific power-of-two partition, not arbitrary Liu markings. Hence Theorem C (the upper-bound obligation) is nowhere established for all n; the objection is correct and fatal as written.
